# Create a new page

# Add page to writer
writer.add_page(page)

from reportlab.platypus import SimpleDocTemplate, Paragraph, Spacer
from reportlab.lib.styles import getSampleStyleSheet
from reportlab.lib.utils import ImageReader
import os

output_path = "/workspace/Protocol_Z_Correspondence_Bundled.pdf"
doc = SimpleDocTemplate(output_path)
styles = getSampleStyleSheet()

story = []
story.append(Spacer(1, 60))
story.append(Paragraph("PROTOCOL Z CORRESPONDENCE BUNDLE", styles["Heading1"]))
story.append(Spacer(1, 30))
story.append(Paragraph("For External Counsel Review", styles["Heading2"]))
story.append(Spacer(1, 30))
story.append(Paragraph("Generated: October 10, 2026", styles["Normal"]))
story.append(Spacer(1, 20))

# Email 1
story.append(Spacer(1, 40))
story.append(Paragraph("EMAIL 1 - Re: Protocol Z discussion and notes", styles["Heading2"]))
story.append(Spacer(1, 20))
story.append(Paragraph("From: leadnegotiator@company.com", styles["Normal"]))
story.append(Paragraph("To: me@company.com", styles["Normal"]))
story.append(Paragraph("CC: other@company.com", styles["Normal"]))
story.append(Spacer(1, 20))
story.append(Paragraph("Hi, Thanks for the updates. I am pasting the thread below for reference.", styles["Normal"]))
story.append(Spacer(1, 20))
story.append(Paragraph("--- Original Message from vendor@vendor.com ---", styles["Normal"]))
story.append(Spacer(1, 10))
story.append(Paragraph("Subject: Protocol Z draft - Please see attached draft.", styles["Normal"]))
story.append(Spacer(1, 10))
story.append(Paragraph("Regards, Vendor Team", styles["Normal"]))
story.append(Spacer(1, 20))
story.append(Paragraph("PRIVILEGED: ATTORNEY-CLIENT - DO NOT PRODUCE.", styles["Normal"]))
story.append(Spacer(1, 20))

# Email 2
story.append(Spacer(1, 40))
story.append(Paragraph("EMAIL 2 - Protocol Z compiled bundles notice", styles["Heading2"]))
story.append(Spacer(1, 20))
story.append(Paragraph("From: legal-assistant@company.com", styles["Normal"]))
story.append(Paragraph("To: me@company.com, leadnegotiator@company.com", styles["Normal"]))
story.append(Spacer(1, 20))
story.append(Paragraph("Hi team, I have prepared two versions of the Protocol Z bundle for external review.", styles["Normal"]))
story.append(Paragraph("- ProtocolZ_bundle_all.pdf (full bundle)", styles["Normal"]))
story.append(Paragraph("- ProtocolZ_bundle_redacted.pdf (bundle with privileged message omitted)", styles["Normal"]))
story.append(Spacer(1, 20))
story.append(Paragraph("Thanks, Alex", styles["Normal"]))
story.append(Spacer(1, 40))
story.append(Paragraph("END OF PROTOCOL Z CORRESPONDENCE BUNDLE", styles["Heading1"]))

doc.build(story)
print("PDF created:", output_path, os.path.getsize(output_path), "bytes")
